description: Preview a UCP checkout and move it to ready-for-payment. Call after destination and shipping are set, before ucp_complete_checkout. Use ONLY for a checkout created with ucp_create_checkout. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

meta.description: UCP request metadata. meta['ucp-agent'].profile = URL of the platform profile; it must be an https URL without credentials (at most 2048 characters).

aud.description: This store's slug (the one in the URL you are calling) — not a domain.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code; must match the cart's currency.

exp.description: Expiry as an INTEGER of Unix seconds, in the future — not an ISO 8601 date string.

max_amount_cents.description: Spending limit the buyer gave you, as an integer in minor units (cents).

sub.description: The identity you authenticate as — it is compared against it. When the credential tool returns a `mandate_subject`, use that value.

payment_mandate.description: Payment mandate with `mandate_id`, `max_amount_cents` (integer, minor units), `currency` (3 letters, must match the cart's), `exp` (expiry as an INTEGER of Unix seconds — not an ISO 8601 date string), `sub` (the identity you authenticate as — it is compared against it) and `aud` (the store slug this mandate is for, e.g. the slug in the URL you are calling — not a domain). It is a spending cap you declare to limit yourself: it authorises nothing and does not prove the buyer's consent. Use this when your client cannot set an `X-Payment-Mandate` header.

name: ucp_preview_checkout
